# Historical inline metadata review

No actionable production defect was found in frozen `990224c8b117b1c36d500e17a8a92460a857ac20787e55562f7e76a94fd9aa14` within its stated metadata-only scope. No Root/frozen-author files were changed and no whole-Core Cargo build was run.

## Independent source checks

All 119 manifest-listed files were verified. All four pure transforms were independently applied to exact committed `cc405ad512923b9e404c7498aa75bdbb1277a2eb` inputs; their Rust1.90 formatted outputs match the frozen previews. The factored live source-outcome body has exactly the original Rust tokens after replacing its two `self.get(&id)?` expressions with the lookup seam. There is one Rustfmt line-wrap difference after indentation changes. The complete-KV hash loop is the exact original text after replacing `data.entries()` with its iterator argument. No source branch, coercion, error transport, mutation order or hash framing change was found in those extractions.

The live wrapper still performs expected-snapshot validation, argument count/value validation and actual complete read before source lookup, then builds its real live plan. Historical lookup reads actual verified old pages and uses the same row/directory/page-split calculation. Its complete Before/After receipts include all actual KV entries. The copied old-view provenance remains separate from original identity; its verified original/copy readers check original row receipts and actual raw data.

## Scope and retained state

`NativeHistoricalInlineDatabaseV1` has no live append plan, writer permit, financial Runtime/Ledger, state importer or source-PC resume capability. The source result is recomputed from the old view and raw arguments. Recorded append verification requires the exact recomputed TLNM, matching original namespace/persistent identity/catalog/context, one logical increment, actual complete Post state and exact directory. Failed verification does not advance its opaque phase. Native application and returning the computed DB result remain distinct phases; no-write/error outcomes cannot verify a fictitious append and can resolve once.

This is intentionally a **metadata relation**, not proof of physical native candidate lineage. It does not bind/authorize Mode4 action selection, supersession, Accepted/ACK, caller/job/scope/operation ordinal or awaited/detached role. Its visitor retains the old read's separate copy descriptor and original Post facts; complete physical/copy/native-candidate closure remains the future caller's responsibility. The patch does not change a cold action dispatcher or admit Mode4 into the existing HISTORY reader. Thus no new cold/financial authority follows from successful metadata resolution.

The existing five author controls cover live/historical result and raw-context/TLNM equality, actual pruned copied pages with a 64→65 split, foreign equal-content origins, wrong TLNM and later state, raw special values and large-page scalar streaming. These are executed metadata cases, not new original-JavaScript observations or a whole-Core/financial result.

## Executed independent controls

The actual copied metadata/source-owner closure passed **135 tests, 1 existing child helper ignored** on Rust1.90. This comprises the author's 133 and two new controls; strict `-D warnings -D clippy::all` passed.

1. **Same-sequence, same-directory, same-size extra change.** An actual native journal write recalculates a valid-CRC Post containing the correct selected update plus a changed unrelated row. It preserves original identity, exactly one sequence increment, the expected directory, complete flag, key count and byte count. Only the complete-state chain differs. Verification refuses without changing any canonical historical fields or the actual current pin, and unresolved result access stays blocked. Removing only the complete-KV hash comparison makes this exact test fail, demonstrating it discriminates that guard instead of relying on sequence/directory mismatch.
2. **Metadata resolution retains the real cold-write guard.** Verify and resolve an actual historical write once while the same current index is under its actual cold capability. Also compute/resolve an actual no-match/no-write outcome once. Neither grants write permission: actual inline append and source put remain `ColdWriteRefused`, current state/pin stays unchanged, and only the separately retained original capability can end that guard. The same future live operation works only after explicit valid guard release.

Both tests reuse the existing parent Temp counter, not a separately counted colliding directory prefix. They are ready as an additive Root leaf/one append transform; Parent owns actual-Core validation.

An attempted extra old-compiled-live-API comparison did not compile because immutable `ad67` exposes no `prepare_inline_database` method. The failed probe/source/log are preserved and it is not counted as evidence or replaced by a self-comparison. `ad67` only supplies existing public dependency types to the actually compiled copied metadata closure. The live-factor preservation conclusion instead rests on the independently verified original-token/hash-body extraction and the executed actual-Journal controls. No prior or current financial-provider behavior is claimed.
